score_metric: VSI-Bench overall average (%): macro-average of multiple-choice accuracy and mean relative accuracy on numerical tasks, across 8 tasks
human_reference_group: Adults employed in occupations where Spatial Orientation has O*NET importance of 3 or higher, judged at the median worker. The original VSI-Bench paper (Yang et al., 'Thinking in Space') reports a human baseline on the VSI-Bench-tiny subset of about 79% overall. Humans score about 94-100% on orientation-type tasks (relative direction, relative distance, route planning, appearance order) and only about 45-60% on metric-estimation tasks (absolute distance, room size, object size).
